subject: general
question: The Mysuru Palace in Karnataka was an official residence of which of the following dynasties?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wadiyar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amba Vilas Palace, commonly known as Mysore Palace, **is a historical palace and a royal house in Mysore, India. It is located in the state of Karnataka, in the city of Mysore.
 
• It serves as the formal residence of the** Wadiyar dynasty **and the capital of the** Mysore Kingdom.** The palace is located in the heart of Mysore, overlooking the Chamundi Hills to the east.
 
• The ground where the palace presently sits was formerly known as puragiri (literally, citadel). It is now known as the old fort.
 
• The original palace inside the Old Fort was built in the 14th century by Yaduraya, and it has been damaged and rebuilt multiple times since then.
 
• Following the fire that destroyed the Old Palace, the current structure was constructed between 1897 and 1912. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• With a brief hiatus in the late 1700s, the **Wadiyar dynasty **controlled the Kingdom of Mysore from 1399 to 1950.
 
• They were a feudatory house under the Vijayanagar Emperor who took advantage of the Empire's weakness to gain independence.
 
• In 1610, Raja Odeyar took control of Srirangapatna, the seat of the Vijaynagar Viceroy.
 
• Following its independence from the British administration, the kingdom was included in the Dominion of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Pallava dynasty** was a Tamil dynasty that ruled over a large part of southern India known as Tondaimandalam from 275 to 897 CE.
 
• Between the 6th and 12th centuries, the **Chalukya dynasty **dominated wide swaths of southern and central India.
 
• **The Chola Dynasty **was a Tamil thalassocratic empire in southern India, and it was one of the world's longest-ruling empires.
